_comment: Rollback artifact for the ryan-realty.com domain cutover (gate LAUNCH-16). REVISED 2026-05-30 after discovering the LIVE DNS is in AgentFire's Cloudflare account (nameservers eva/jeff), NOT Matt's. Cutover mechanism is therefore a REGISTRAR (GoDaddy) NAMESERVER SWITCH to Matt's own Cloudflare zone (novalee/yahir), not an in-place A/CNAME edit. Rollback = revert GoDaddy nameservers to eva/jeff. AgentFire's zone is never modified, so it stays a clean revert target.
registrar: GoDaddy (godaddy.com, llc, id 146) — domain registration + where nameservers are set

liveZone_AgentFire.owner: AgentFire's Cloudflare account (Matt does NOT control it)
liveZone_AgentFire.status: ACTIVE / authoritative now — serves AgentFire site + Google Workspace email + go/seller (Vercel)
liveZone_AgentFire.rule: DO NOT MODIFY. It stays intact as the rollback target.

targetZone_Matt.status: initializing (pending) — activates ONLY when GoDaddy NS are switched to these
targetZone_Matt.rule: Build the FULL record set here (Vercel apex/www DNS-only + Google Workspace email + go/seller + verifications) and verify BEFORE switching NS.

liveRecordsInventory_fromDig._source: dig against authoritative servers 2026-05-30 (eva/jeff). Proxied records hide their origin; values below are what resolves.
liveRecordsInventory_fromDig.TXT_dkim_google._domainkey: v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=<long key present> — SOURCE THE EXACT VALUE FROM GOOGLE ADMIN CONSOLE, do not trust a dig-truncated copy
liveRecordsInventory_fromDig.mail: proxied (104.21.28.38/172.67.144.15) — AgentFire artifact; likely drop (Google webmail is mail.google.com)
liveRecordsInventory_fromDig.autodiscover: proxied — AgentFire artifact; not needed with Google Workspace; likely drop
liveRecordsInventory_fromDig.CAVEAT: dig only reveals records we explicitly query AND that are publicly resolvable. AgentFire's zone may contain ADDITIONAL records we cannot enumerate without account access. Before the NS switch, reconcile against Cloudflare's auto-scan in the target zone AND ideally an AgentFire zone export for 100% completeness.

cutover.mechanism: In GoDaddy, change the domain's nameservers from [eva, jeff].ns.cloudflare.com to [novalee, yahir].ns.cloudflare.com. This makes Matt's pre-built Cloudflare zone authoritative (apex/www -> Vercel) in one move.
prereqs: Matt's CF zone (novalee/yahir) fully built + verified: apex A 76.76.21.21 + www CNAME cname.vercel-dns.com (DNS-only/grey), Google Workspace MX + SPF + DKIM + DMARC replicated exactly, go + seller CNAMEs to Vercel, google + tiktok verification TXT.
ryan-realty.com + www.ryan-realty.com added + showing Valid Configuration on the Vercel project.
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://ryan-realty.com carried in a fresh green production deploy.
Lower TTLs in the target zone (300s) before the switch.
cutover.irreversibleStep: The GoDaddy NS switch is the public point of no easy return (NS-change propagation is bounded by the registrar/TLD TTL and resolver NS caching — can be slower than an A-record change).

rollback.trigger: Any post-cutover smoke fails: site not the new Next.js app, /lp/seller-home-value 404, leads not reaching FUB, OR Google Workspace email stops flowing.
steps: In GoDaddy, revert the domain nameservers from [novalee, yahir].ns.cloudflare.com back to [eva, jeff].ns.cloudflare.com.
AgentFire's Cloudflare zone was never modified, so reverting NS restores the exact prior state (AgentFire site + Google email + go/seller).
Confirm: dig +short ryan-realty.com NS shows eva/jeff again, and curl -sI https://ryan-realty.com returns x-powered-by: AgentFire.com.
rollback.rollbackTarget: AgentFire's eva/jeff Cloudflare zone — untouched throughout, so a clean revert.
rollback.rollbackTargetStillLive: VERIFIED 2026-05-30: apex 200 from AgentFire, www 301 -> apex. AgentFire hosting MUST stay active/paid through at least 48h post-cutover.
